correctness.rationale: The seven displayed homogeneous harmonic cubics form a basis of H3. Gamma-function integration of octant monomials gives the full-sphere diagonal Gram and regional seven-by-seven blocks, with exact mass normalization 1/8. The permutation representation decomposes into alternating one-dimensional, trivial two-dimensional and standard four-dimensional sectors. The alternating eigenvalue is (π-3)/(8π); the two quadratic block roots are (30π-5±√6505)/(240π), each simple, and (30π+25±√4045)/(240π), each doubled. Exact dimension 1+2+4=7 and radical inequalities order them; min-max gives sharp values and eigenspace dimensions. Read check_exact.py using symbolic gamma moments for all 49 Gram products and independently recomputed the matrix/spectrum with SymPy plus numerical eigensolver; no reliance on quadrature as proof.

value.rationale: The positive octant is a canonical non-cap spherical observation region. Its pure cubic band has a nontrivial permutation-symmetry degeneracy: a two-dimensional optimal eigenspace versus unique least mode. Full exact evaluated spectrum and sharp concentration bounds give a meaningful natural finite-band spectral invariant, separate from generic matrix recipes and other-degree/octant or cap results.

final_claim: Complete positive surface-octant S² concentration spectrum for pure degree-three spherical harmonics: five algebraic π levels with multiplicities (1,1,2,1,2), a unique alternating minimum line and a two-dimensional top standard-sector eigenspace.
limitations: Only pure degree three on a positive surface octant; not entire low-pass band, discrete sensors, or noise model.
Exact block calculation supplies proof; finite quadrature and decimal comparisons are corroboration only.
